''See also: [[Gilad Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Gilad is a young [[Traveler]] recognized for his exceptional abilities, often being referred to as a genius. He is one of the rare individuals in [[Enosh]] who possesses connections to two separate Territories, allowing him to draw power from both [[Helgard]] and [[Naraka]] with similar proficiency. His combat prowess is significant; he once defeated a group of Itasas Tribesmen and a hunting squad sent by [[Damasca]]. During his escape from [[Naraka]], he successfully infiltrated a [[Damascan]] outpost and utilized an unguarded waypoint to open a Gate, which allowed him to return home despite being surrounded by enemy soldiers. While he is highly respected due to his unique bonds, he can also appear timid or easily flustered in certain social interactions. His abilities include performing summons and sensing environmental elements, though he has also been known to experience physical exhaustion or sudden distress.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Gilad possesses a red symbol on his right palm known as the [[Naraka brand]]. This mark is capable of leaving streaks of light in the air.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|A genius traveler from the free city of [[Enosh]], Gilad has established bonds with two different Territories. He is capable of overwhelming entire groups of people singlehandedly, including tribesmen and squads of travelers.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Gilad is positioned behind [[Alin]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Gilad can perform a [[Helgard]] summons and call down fire from the sky. His techniques include creating an almost-invisible ripple from his hand and summoning a bright orange fireball composed of screaming faces.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Infiltration of Naraka}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|While infiltrating a [[Damascan]] outpost in [[Naraka]], Gilad singlehandedly overpowered a squad of [[Travelers]] sent by [[Damasca]] along with the Itasas Tribesmen before opening a Gate to return to their world.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c10">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 10</ref> During this time, he demonstrated the ability to perform a [[Helgard]] summons and conjure a bright orange fireball composed of screaming faces, though he was eventually cut off mid-chant.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c10" /> Following a period where he lay unconscious on the grass outside [[Elysia]], Gilad was later seen standing behind [[Alin]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c11">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 11</ref> This [[Traveler]] utilizes a long-handled brand in combat.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c19">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c21">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 21</ref>}}
